Kiran and Pallavi Patel Global University Grievance Redressal COMMITTEE OVERVIEW About the committee A grievance encompasses any manifestation of discontent, dissatisfaction, or negative perception, whether articulated or not, stemming from any aspect associated with the University, which a student perceives, or even senses, as being unjust, inequitable, or unfair. The Grievance Redressal System is a vital part of any administration.

title: Grievance Redressal Committee | KPGU
content: sal System is a vital part of any administration. It falls under the purview of University Administration to ensure the provision of a secure and conducive environment for the students. In accordance with UGC guidelines, the Grievance Redressal Committee has been established within the university to address grievances raised by the students. This platform facilitates an open forum for students to express their concerns, and it is crucial for the complainant to exercise diligence and discretion i

title: Grievance Redressal Committee | KPGU
content: complainant to exercise diligence and discretion in determining what constitutes a grievance significant enough to warrant the attention of the committee, which consists of senior administrators and faculty members of the university. PURPOSE Objectives of the Committee Objective 01 To provide a platform for students to address their grievances related to academic, administrative, or personal matters within the university.

title: Grievance Redressal Committee | KPGU
content: ative, or personal matters within the university. Objective 02 To ensure that grievances are addressed impartially and in a fair manner, without any bias or discrimination. Objective 03 To maintain confidentiality and privacy throughout the grievance resolution process, safeguarding the interests of all parties involved. Objective 04 To promote transparency in the handling of grievances by keeping all stakeholders informed about the progress and outcomes of the resolution process.

title: Grievance Redressal Committee | KPGU
content: progress and outcomes of the resolution process. Objective 05 To identify root causes of grievances and recommend measures to prevent their recurrence in the future, thereby fostering a positive and conducive environment within the university. Objective 06 To educate students about the grievance redressal mechanism and their rights and responsibilities in lodging and resolving grievances. Objective 07 To regularly review and improve the grievance redressal process based on feedback and emerging

title: Grievance Redressal Committee | KPGU
content: e redressal process based on feedback and emerging needs, ensuring its effectiveness and efficiency. Objective 08 To facilitate amicable resolution of grievances through mediation, negotiation, or other appropriate means, aiming for mutual understanding and agreement. Kiran and Pallavi Patel Global University Constitution of Prevention and Prohibition of Ragging CONSTITUTION OF PREVENTION AND PROHIBITION OF RAGGING Anti-Ragging Committee In pursuance of the Judgment of the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India dated 08.05.2009 in Civil Appeal No. 887/2009, the University Grants Commission has framed  UGC Regulations on curbing the menace of ragging in higher educational institutions, 2009  which have been notified on 4th July, 200

title: Anti-Ragging Cell | KPGU
content: s, 2009  which have been notified on 4th July, 2009 in the Gazette of India. Ragging is a form of abuse on newcomers to any institution and these regulations are intended to check the menace of ragging. STRICT ENFORCEMENT Legal measures & disciplinary actions Ragging is a criminal offense. Ragging is strictly prohibited by both State Govt. and Central Govt. Punishment for ragging will be as follows: 01 Cancellation of admission. 02 Suspension from attending classes.

title: Anti-Ragging Cell | KPGU
content: admission. 02 Suspension from attending classes. 03 Withholding or withdrawing scholarship, fellowship and other benefits. 04 Debarring from appearing in any test, examination, placement activity, or other evaluation process. 05 Withholding results. 06 Debarring from representing the institution in any regional, national, or international meet, tournament, youth festival, etc. 07 Suspension or expulsion from the Hall of Residence. 08 Rustication from the University.

title: Anti-Ragging Cell | KPGU
content: of Residence. 08 Rustication from the University. 09 Expulsion from the institution and consequent debarring from admission to any other institution. 10 Fine will be imposed as per severity of an offense. 11 Collective punishment: when the persons committing or abetting the crime of ragging are not identified, the institution will resort to collective punishment as a deterrent to ensure community pressure on the potential offenders.

content:

Step 2: Document Submission & Verification of 10th/12th marksheets, entrance exam scorecards (KSET / GUJCET / NEET / ACPC), and photo ID.

title: KPGU Admission Eligibility Criteria & Application Procedure
content:
Introduction
KPGU Admission Eligibility Requirements & Application Guidelines: - Undergraduate (UG) Programs (B.Tech, B.Pharm, BBA, B.Sc, BPT, BAMS): Passed 10+2 (HSC) in relevant stream (Science / Commerce / Arts) from GSEB, CBSE, ICSE, or equivalent recognized board with minimum 45%-50% aggregate marks. - Diploma to Degree (D2D) Lateral Entry: Passed Diploma Engineering / Pharmacy in relevant branch with valid ACPC D2D merit rank.

title: KSET Entrance & Scholarship Examination
content:
Introduction
KSET (KPGU Entrance and Scholarship Test) is the university-level entrance examination conducted by Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU), Vadodara. KSET eligibility: Candidates appearing or passed 10+2 or equivalent exam. KSET provides merit-based scholarships up to 100% tuition fee waiver for B.Tech Engineering, B.Pharm, BBA, MBA, and Science programs. Exam dates, syllabus, and online application forms are available on the official KPGU website.

title: Faculty Details - Dr. Rocky Upadhyay
content:
Introduction
Dr. Rocky Upadhyay is the Head of Department (HOD) and Professor of Computer Science & Engineering (CSE) at Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU), Vadodara. He leads the CSE department, overseeing curriculum design, research labs, AI/ML projects, and student academic welfare.

title: Hostel Facilities & Accommodation Options
content:
Introduction
KPGU Vadodara offers spacious, secure on-campus accommodation with separate hostels for boys and girls. Facilities include 24x7 CCTV security, high-speed Wi-Fi, fully furnished single and double rooms, continuous water and power supply, dedicated study rooms, laundry facilities, and a hygienic vegetarian mess providing nutritious meals.

title: B.Tech Computer Science Engineering Program
content:
Introduction
B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering (CSE) at KPGU Vadodara is a 4-year undergraduate degree program. Curriculum covers Data Structures, Algorithms, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Web Development, Cybersecurity, and Software Engineering. Annual tuition fee: Rs 85,000.

title: Faculty Details - Dr. Patel (CSE)
content:
Introduction
Dr. Patel is a Senior Professor in the Department of Computer Science & Engineering (CSE) at KPGU Vadodara, specializing in Data Structures, Database Systems, and Cloud Computing.

title: Faculty Details - Dr. Patel (Pharmacy)
content:
Introduction
Dr. Patel is a Professor in the Faculty of Pharmacy at KPGU Vadodara, specializing in Pharmaceutics, Drug Delivery Systems, and Pharmaceutical Chemistry.
